I met Brandon on a local brook trout stream, high on the fringes of the Island Park Plateau, just a stone’s throw from Yellowstone National Park. He handed me a handsome gray case containing the Moonlit Lunar S-Glass 6-foot, 6-inch 2-weight rod.
